frozen_ground.says: modelled mean annual ground temperature at the top of the permafrost, 2000 to 2016, and permafrost probability
frozen_ground.not_meaning: not lunar ice, not ice content, not a measurement at the site; Northern Hemisphere north of 25°N only
frozen_ground.threshold: E4: frozen ground for drilling at -6 °C or colder; partial between -6 and 0 °C
frozen_ground.sigma: standard deviation of the model (MAGTSTD), not interannual

aridity.says: aridity index: mean annual precipitation over reference evapotranspiration, 1970 to 2000
aridity.not_meaning: not the water content of the ground; not lunar dryness (the Moon has no atmosphere)
aridity.threshold: UNEP classes: hyper-arid < 0.03, arid < 0.2, semi-arid < 0.5, dry sub-humid < 0.65, humid
aridity.no_data: 0 in the file (sea, or an index below 0.0001: not told apart) is treated as no data
